dedupe_keys.name: hifld open liquified natural gas lng import and export terminals

description: HIFLD Open Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) Import and Export Terminals is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (Energy Information Administration et al.). This is a point dataset representing liquefied natural gas import/export terminals in the United States. These are defined as terminals capable of liquefaction of natural gas for transport or receipt and regasification of LNG for use as natural gas. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
